name: pstack-resident
description: Standalone resident-mode hook for pstack-zcode users who installed the skills via npx skills add: a SessionStart hook injecting the condensed poteto-mode summary into sessions where poteto-mode is reachable (project-level install in the tree, or a global install under the home directory). Install this only alongside the skills route; the pstack-zcode full-collection plugin already carries this hook behind a settings toggle.
